comment: Trade network without physical transport (GDD 4, CORE simplified; stage 3e). Settlements of one civilization on one world are in one network when a chain of settlements links them, each link at most linkCells apart. Goods passed between two settlements lose lossPercentPerCell percent for every cell of distance (at most 90%); sharedStore: true while the network of a civilization is one shared store until the bronze age (ADR 0026 rule 5): goods pass between its settlements without loss (trade with other peoples still loses). Internal prices stay as the AI's measure of what is scarce. Shortages are shared in the order of GDD 4.5: food for the people first (each settlement keeps foodReserveYears of its food needs), then the goods of higher needs, then the inputs of the recipes being worked; what is left over stays where it is. A warehouse that overflows first sends the surplus to settlements of its network with room. Internal prices: the good's value from goods.json times demand over supply (demand = a year of needs and recipe inputs), within priceRangePercent.
